Video timing

Choose Correct using capture fps only if a slow-motion video’s timestamps were rewritten for playback. Use it when the capture fps is known, constant, and no frames are missing.After changing this setting, recreate the photo to update coordinate timestamps and time graphs.

Capture fps is not guessed automatically. If it is unknown, use File frame times.
